question_text: A former mayor is charged with graft and corrupt practices for allegedly overpricing a government infrastructure project. Which court has jurisdiction over this case?

options.text: Regional Trial Court (RTC) of the province where the project was located.
Sandiganbayan, as it involves a public official and allegations of graft.
Supreme Court, as it involves a former local executive.
Court of Appeals, as it is a criminal case involving government funds.
